sourceFile: 17. MSU-L20S15-07 Report check VP Froming machine - 2025.04.05_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft misidentifies the changed factor and uses invalid mixed measurement statistics, so it cannot be final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is a filename, not a source-supported condition.
Baseline/test condition is not explicit; source is a machine abnormality check.
Measurement stats mix different metrics and units into meaningless averages.
Actual result rows are not cited for the generated stats.
Decision row is omitted from outcome evidence.
correctionPlan: Reframe as VP forming machine condition check tied to high NG hearing, or exclude if changed-condition evidence is required.
Separate outcomes by metric: temperature, cooling temperature, pressure and any other source rows.
Cite each actual measurement/spec row used, not only the header row.
Use spec compliance per metric instead of cross-metric min/max/avg.
Add the decision row supporting no abnormality found.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; header and context rows do not support the numeric outcomes.
